principal_evidence: No Milliquas, DESI DR1 or SDSS DR19 quasar counterpart. Gaia stellar probabilities are 0.869 and 0.99993. Survey catalogues place the extended source on the fainter object.

The two-filter central profile and SIE fit are positive. DESI and legacy SDSS measured the same bright z=0.183 nucleus. SDSS catalogued the faint component as a galaxy in 2007. The repeated quasar image and an independently identifiable intervening galaxy remain unresolved.
